rows.grounds: relative pronoun introducing the result obtained
third person singular active present of root prāp
demonstrative pronoun referring to the fruit
atra means here and eva adds emphasis itself
sakṛt means once, piṇḍa means ball of rice, pradānataḥ means from or by offering

items.question: What fruit is obtained here itself by offering a rice-ball once?
premises: A single rice-ball offering is made here.
The same fruit is obtained by that offering.
The result is not deferred to another place.
items.inference: One rice-ball offering at this place itself yields the corresponding fruit.
uncertainties: The exact referent of tat depends on the preceding verses.
Whether atra refers to the sacred field or another site is context-dependent.
items.plain_english: What one obtains, that is obtained right here by offering a rice-ball once.
